description: A 64-stage shift register: a level read in on one clock edge comes back out 64 clock edges later.

inputs.text: The level read into the register on each rising clock edge while MODE is low.
A rising edge shifts the register one place along and reads in whichever data input MODE has selected.
The level read into the register on each rising clock edge while MODE is high; patch Q here to make the register loop its contents round.
Chooses which jack the register reads: the DATA jack while this is low, the RECIRCULATE jack while it is high.

outputs.text: The clock input passed on one sample late, for clocking a second register from the same edge without a race.
The level that was read into the register 64 clock edges ago.
The inverse of Q: 10V when the level read in 64 clock edges ago was low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
With nothing patched into MODE the register reads the DATA jack.
